description: Only when your user asked. Gets a non-binding monthly price range for a US business under 50 seats. It is an estimate, not a quote: request_full_quote hands it to a person for a follow-up, and check_fit gives a quick verdict without one. Saves the estimate as a lead for the Managed Nerds team; nothing is emailed to the buyer. Returns estimate_id, status, monthly_range_usd, valid_until, assumptions, included, not_included, status_url and pdf_url. If status is needs_info, missing lists what to add. A revision is another call with revises and status_token (up to 5 revisions).

also_interested_in.description: Other service ids from list_services that the user wants quoted by a person

state.description: US state, such as GA or SC

website.description: Website address, if it has one

computers.description: How many computers to cover, by type. Leave out types the business doesn't have

revises.description: To revise an earlier estimate, its estimate_id. Needs status_token. Contact and business stay as first given

rmm.description: Huntress EDR needs an RMM agent: ours, or the client's own if they accept limited remediation during an incident

accepts_limited_remediation.description: Whether they accept limited remediation during an incident if they keep their own RMM

has_own_rmm.description: Whether the business already has its own RMM

service_model.description: co_managed (default): our security tools alongside their own IT. managed: we run their IT, priced from computers, users and tenant. Managed IT support time is billed separately: hourly, or from an optional pre-paid block (support)

services.description: Co-managed security to price: edr (endpoint detection and response), itdr (identity threat detection, all or nothing for a tenant), sat (security awareness training), siem, espm (per Windows or Mac computer, needs EDR). Leave out for managed IT

status_token.description: The token from the earlier estimate's status_url

support.description: Managed IT only: a pre-paid block of support hours a month, shown as its own range. Optional: the user chooses whether to have one

hours_per_month.description: Support hours a month, 0.5 or more

non_technical_users.description: How many non-technical users, for our suggested block (half an hour a month each)

tenant.description: Its email and identity platform: m365 (Microsoft 365) or gws (Google Workspace)

user_approved.description: True only when the user asked for this

user_request.description: What the user asked for, in their words

users.description: All licensed Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace users in the tenant. ITDR covers every one of them, never just a few

name: preliminary_estimate

message.description: What the result means, when there is something to say

monthly_range_usd.description: The monthly range, before volume discounts

next.description: How to ask for the full quote

pdf_url.description: The estimate as a one-page PDF

revision.description: How many times this estimate was revised

scoped_on_call.description: What a person scopes on a call

valid_until.description: Date the estimate is valid until
